items.question: How does the subscription work?
items.answer: You choose a plan (Pro or Business) with monthly or annual billing. The subscription is automatically renewed each period. You can cancel at any time from your company space, with no fees.

items.question: Can I change my plan at any time?
items.answer: Yes, you can switch from one plan to another at any time. If you upgrade, you only pay the difference prorated to the remaining days. If you downgrade, the change will take effect at the next billing date.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees or commitments?
items.answer: No hidden fees. The prices displayed are final, including all taxes. There is no long-term commitment: you can cancel at any time.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Of course. Cancellation is done in one click from your company space, in the 'Subscription' section. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the paid period.

items.question: Do my job offers remain online after the subscription ends?
items.answer: Yes, your active jobs remain published until their normal expiration date. You simply won't be able to post new ones if you have reached the limit of your new plan.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept international credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor.

items.question: How is billing data handled?
items.answer: Your billing data is stored securely and never shared with third parties.

items.question: Do you offer solutions for large groups?
items.answer: Yes, we offer custom Enterprise plans. Contact our sales team via the Contact page to discuss your needs.

items.question: Can I use the free plan indefinitely?
items.answer: The free plan allows you to test the platform with 3 active jobs. It has no time limit.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my job limit?
items.answer: If you reach your plan's limit, you won't be able to post new jobs. You can either archive old jobs or upgrade to the next plan.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: We offer a 14-day guarantee for new subscribers. If you are not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to your questions about Actoos Jobs.
faq.noResultsHint: Try different keywords or browse the categories.

questions.q: What is Actoos Jobs?
questions.a: Actoos Jobs is the leading recruitment platform in Mali and West Africa. We connect qualified candidates with local and international companies. You can search for jobs, apply easily, and track your applications. Recruiters can post jobs, manage applications, and schedule interviews, all for free with a premium subscription option.

questions.q: Is registration free?
questions.a: Yes, registration and basic use are completely free for candidates. Companies can also create a free account and post a limited number of jobs. Paid plans are available for advanced features (more jobs, increased visibility, etc.).

questions.q: How do I create an account?
questions.a: Click on 'Register' at the top right of the site. You can choose a Candidate or Company account. Fill in the form with your email and a password, or quickly log in with Google. Your account will be created instantly.

questions.q: How do I apply for a job?
questions.a: Browse jobs from the 'Jobs' page. Click on a job to see the details, then on 'Apply'. If you haven't completed your profile yet, we will invite you to do so to optimize your chances. Once your application is sent, the company is immediately notified.

questions.q: What is the matching score?
questions.a: It's an estimate of the match between your profile and a job. The higher the score, the more your skills, experience, and salary expectations match what the employer is looking for. It helps you identify the most promising jobs for you.

questions.q: Can I save jobs for later?
questions.a: Absolutely. Click the heart at the top right of the job to add it to your favorites. Find them in your dashboard, under 'Saved jobs'.

questions.q: How do job alerts work?
questions.a: From your dashboard, go to 'Job alerts'. Define your criteria (keywords, city, category, minimum salary, frequency). You will receive an email as soon as a matching job is posted.

questions.q: What should I do if I encounter a technical problem?
questions.a: You can contact us via the contact form (Contact page) or report inappropriate content directly from the job. Our team responds quickly.

questions.q: How do I create a company profile?
questions.a: After creating a 'Company' type account, go to your dashboard and click on 'Create my company'. Fill in the requested information (name, industry, description, logo, etc.). Your company will be submitted for validation by our team. Once validated, you can post jobs.

questions.q: Why is my company pending validation?
questions.a: To ensure the quality and reliability of the offers, we manually verify each new company. This usually takes less than 24 hours. You will be notified by email upon validation. In the meantime, you can prepare your jobs as drafts.

questions.q: How many jobs can I post?
questions.a: With the free plan, you can post 1 active job. The Pro and Business plans allow you to post more jobs simultaneously. You can always save unlimited drafts. Check the 'Pricing' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I manage received applications?
questions.a: In your dashboard, go to 'Applications'. You will see all applications sorted by job. You can change the status (viewed, shortlisted, interview, accepted, rejected). The candidate will be automatically notified by email.

questions.q: Can I schedule a video interview directly from the platform?
questions.a: Yes, on the application detail page, you can generate a Jitsi video conference link in one click and send it by email to the candidate. You can also use our AI assistant to prepare personalized interview questions.

questions.q: How do I cancel my paid subscription?
questions.a: Go to your dashboard, in the subscription section, click on 'Cancel'. You can indicate the reason (optional). Your subscription will be immediately downgraded to the free plan. You will no longer be billed.

questions.q: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) via our partner Stripe. All payments are secure and in FCFA (XOF).

questions.q: Can I change plans at any time?
questions.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade. The difference will be calculated pro-rata. Annual plans offer a 20% discount.

questions.q: What happens after a cancellation?
questions.a: Your account remains active and your posted jobs remain online until they expire. You switch back to the free plan and lose access to premium features (additional jobs, boosts, etc.).

questions.q: Is my personal data protected?
questions.a: Yes. We enforce a strict privacy policy. Your information is never shared without your consent. See our 'Privacy' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I report a fraudulent job or abuse?
questions.a: On every job and every company page, you will find a 'Report' button. Select the reason and describe the problem. Our moderation team reviews each report as quickly as possible.

questions.q: Can I delete my account?
questions.a: Yes, contact us via the contact form indicating your request. We will proceed to delete your account and all associated data in accordance with the regulations.

whatIsCookie.title: 1. What is a cookie?
whatIsCookie.content: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, phone, tablet) when you visit a website. Cookies allow the site to recognize your device and remember certain information about your preferences or past actions.

subsections.title: Essential cookies
subsections.content: Necessary for the operation of the Platform. They enable the use of basic features such as secure login and navigation between pages.

subsections.title: Preference cookies
subsections.content: Allow the memorization of your preferences (language, region, display settings) to personalize your experience.

subsections.title: Analytical cookies
subsections.content: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site by collecting anonymous information on pages visited and time spent.

subsections.title: Marketing cookies
subsections.content: Used to track visitors across websites and display relevant and interesting advertisements to the user.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-party cookies
thirdParty.content:
We use third-party services that may set cookies:
- Google Analytics - Traffic analysis
- Supabase - Authentication and backend services
- Stripe - Payment processing (for premium offers)

manageCookies.title: 4. Managing cookies
manageCookies.content:
You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish:
- Through your browser settings
- Using our cookie consent banner
- Installing cookie blocking extensions

Note: Disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on the Platform.

browserSettings.title: 5. Browser settings

- Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
- Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies
- Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies
- Edge: Settings > Privacy > Cookies

items.title: How to write a standout CV in 2026
items.excerpt: Discover the best practices for creating a modern and effective CV that will catch recruiters' attention.
items.content:
Introduction

A well-written CV is your passport to landing an interview. Here are the golden rules for 2026.

1. Personalize your CV for each job

Adapt the title, skills, and experience according to the job ad.

2. Pay attention to form

Use an airy layout, a readable font, and PDF format.

3. Highlight your achievements

Quantify your results: "Increased revenue by 20%".

Apply these tips and you will increase your chances of being noticed.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: Top 10 mistakes to avoid in a job interview
items.excerpt: Prepare yourself as well as possible for your interviews by avoiding these common mistakes most candidates make.
items.content:
Fatal mistakes in an interview

Here are the traps to avoid to make a good impression.

1. Arriving late

Allow a 15-minute margin.

2. Not researching the company

Show that you know their activity and values.

3. Only talking about yourself

Ask relevant questions about the position.

Avoiding these mistakes will help you succeed in your interview.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: Negotiating your salary: a complete guide
items.excerpt: Learn how to negotiate your salary with confidence and get the compensation you deserve.
items.content:
Why negotiate?

Salary negotiation is a crucial step. Here's how to go about it.

1. Know your market value

Use tools like Glassdoor or PayScale.

2. Wait for the right moment

Address the subject after you have proven your value.

3. Propose a range

Give a realistic range and justify it.

With these tips, you will maximize your compensation.
items.author: Actoos Team

items.title: Career change: where to start?
items.excerpt: Want to change careers? Here are the key steps to successfully make a professional transition.
items.content:
Skills assessment

Identify your strengths and aspirations.

1. Take stock of your situation

What really motivates you?

2. Train

Explore available training, online or in-person.

3. Network

Meet professionals in the targeted sector.

A successful career change takes time and method.
